meta.notes: A key bind adds a key to the Controls screen. default_key names the key as vanilla does (key.keyboard.z); players can rebind it. category and category_name give the Controls group. when on_foot makes it work only while the player rides nothing, and cooldown_ticks 20 allows one press a second. msm:on_press names the event msm_examples:dash_press, run with the player as self: it launches the player forward, plays a whoosh and empties the charge bar. Key binds need the Fabric mod jar export; a new one needs a restart.
